    // One half of a cell, split along the (column, row) to (column + 1, row + 1)
    // diagonal and wound to match `GridQuad`.
    GridTriangle(self: ClothGrid3D, column: Integer, row: Integer, half: Integer): TriangleFace
        => half == 0
            ? TriangleFace(self.GridVertexIndex(column, row),
                           self.GridVertexIndex(column + 1, row),
                           self.GridVertexIndex(column + 1, row + 1))
            : TriangleFace(self.GridVertexIndex(column, row),
                           self.GridVertexIndex(column + 1, row + 1),
                           self.GridVertexIndex(column, row + 1));
